channels.albedo: sRGB Source base plus recovered VMT detail; preserve artwork and alpha semantics
channels.normal: Original Source tangent normals; linear data; scale applies once to XY, then normalize
channels.materialDesktop: glTF G=forward roughness, B=bounded scalar Source Phong strength; R unused
channels.materialRuntime: R=scalar specular strength, G=forward roughness, B unused; identity factors
channels.emissive: sRGB encoded original base-alpha selfillum mask and bounded authored tint; factor applies in linear space once

renderer.lightingAuthority: Native MPH material lighting; unlit groups do not become physically lit
renderer.priority: Native double damage, damage/freeze/bright/team/cosmetic presentation remains authoritative

preservation.sourceAlbedoAndNormalPayloads: Lock accepted desktop payloads and factors; no procedural de-lighting or regeneration
preservation.sharedVariants: Share identical image payloads across geometry variants; native identities may differ by tier
preservation.recolors: Native suit/team albedo variants retain original normal/specular/emission companions
preservation.samus: Keep baseline entries and all referenced desktop/mobile files byte-exact

remainingArtWork: Artist-reviewed selective removal of painted highlights and cavity lighting from albedo
Material-region roughness/specular masks where constant Source Phong masks are insufficient
Controlled emission brightness/hue review, including bounded HDR Source tints
Retain Source normals and repaint only a demonstrated missing surface detail
Selective repaint at real texel density; repeated atlas width is not a genuine 4K repaint
scope: Source material fidelity contract and preservation audit, not a new artwork/PBR remaster, GPU acceptance, or Android display/performance proof. Compression/resize fidelity is audited separately by mobile tooling.
